_about: Discovery partitions (devops/discovery_plan.py). One lane per job site, never mixed. partitions: how many independent machines read that site's boards; max_partitions: the most it may ever be split into; budget: the most boards of that site read at the same moment across ALL its partitions (one_host sites: machines asking the one host at once). Raising the total spreads a site's boards over more machines but never raises its budget. A site not listed gets one partition. Budgets start at what one machine already used for a site (6 boards at once; 1 machine for a one-host site), Greenhouse at 2 machines: raising one is a deliberate change, watched for 429s.
